decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure probe has positive early evidence, and demand for heat pumps and geothermal energy is rising, so the option is worth keeping and likely expanding.
The standard single-U probe fits a growing geothermal market and costs little to keep within an existing pipe production line, so dropping it is not justified.
The surface technology supports the probe range at low cost, and its prospects are still uncertain in a growing market, so the option stays open.
The fire-protection profile system is a core, regulation-driven segment of the steel profile business, and nothing in the results argues for abandoning it.
Slim steel profiles meet architectural demand for slim designs and share tooling with the established profile business, so keeping them costs little.
The decorative surface system is a cheap add-on option whose value is still unresolved, so it is kept, though it is somewhat more at risk than the others.
